before.text_control_path: timer_interval every 1 second -> bus.memory.get(bucket XiaoYu, limit 20)
before.quiet_reconcile_cost: while quiet, the same timer also queried proactive_controller state every scan
before.risk: permanent polling generated avoidable IPC/storage reads and amplified quiet-mode controller RPC/log traffic

after.primary_text_control_path: startup conversations_v2.get baseline -> conversations_v2 record watcher; no healthy-path memory polling
after.event: watcher record subscription with event-id dedupe and observed_at high-water cursor
after.timer: 30-second reconcile only for bounded quiet expiry, watcher restart, or bounded incremental conversations_v2 fallback

migration.first_upgrade_behavior: explicit one-shot conversations_v2.get baselines recent text without replaying old control commands
migration.restart_behavior: later initial views process only unseen records newer than the high-water cursor

expected_steady_state_reduction.normal_mode: 60 memory reads/minute -> 0 memory reads/minute on healthy watcher
expected_steady_state_reduction.quiet_mode: up to ~60 controller-state reconciliations/minute -> at most ~2/minute from 30-second reconcile
